description:
Host-managed setup only. The user adds the TalentLMS API key and domain in Settings → Connectors in the app. Do not ask for or accept the key in chat.

WORKFLOW:
1. Go to your TalentLMS admin panel → Account & Settings → Security
2. Enable API access
3. Copy the API key
4. Your domain is the subdomain part of your URL (e.g., "acme" for acme.talentlms.com)

Note: Requires a paid TalentLMS plan and Super Admin access.
name: configure_talentlms
